name: Delos
description: Delos is a tiny island beside Mykonos in the heart of the Cyclades, said in Greek myth to be the birthplace of Apollo and Artemis. Pilgrims once flocked to its sanctuary, and the island grew into a busy trading port. Today you can wander its sprawling ruins, from ancient harbour quarters to the slopes of Mount Cynthus, where a sanctuary of Zeus once stood.
